evidenceStatus: USER_SUPPLIED_EVIDENCE: authenticated as files supplied by the repository owner; current repository bytes are Git-tracked, but no historic hash/reference proves byte identity to a historical generated matrix.
collectionMethod: Read complete CSV files; computed SHA-256 and byte sizes; queried Git metadata only. No market-data file, generated data, backtest, optimization, holdout, Phase A/B, Alpha, prop, portfolio, live action, or candidate execution was accessed.

matrices.rankSemantics: PROVEN from current generator code: robust_rank is global descending robust_score rank after the generator's stated sort/tie order; ranks 1..1350 are unique and contiguous. A matrix row proves only its reported parameter/result, not historical execution mechanics.
internalInconsistencies: 270 policy-A rows have an empty post_tp1_stop_fib_ratio while other policies report a ratio.
The same reported result vector repeats across distinct min_move/min_distance parameter rows; these are not byte-identical rows because parameter and rank fields differ.

matrices.rankSemantics: PROVEN from current generator code: robust_rank is global descending robust_score rank after stated sort/tie order; ranks 1..88 are unique and contiguous. v6_selection_robust_rank/score identify the selected V6 row reported by the V6.5 generator, not independent historical provenance.
internalInconsistencies: Eight no_stop_movement rows use an empty post_tp1_stop_fib_ratio.
CSV serializes the 0.830 setting as numeric text 0.83 while stop_policy says Fib 0.830; numerically consistent but textually non-identical.

matrixDifferences: V6 has 1,350 rows, five policies, 65 columns, includes GOLD, and varies five min_distance by six min_move values.
V6.5 has 88 rows, 11 stop placements, 54 columns, excludes GOLD, and carries V6 selection policy/rank/score fields plus placement-specific penalties.

V6 reports policy-C comparative fields suffixed _vs_A and concentration/performance-instability penalties; V6.5 reports comparisons _vs_0880 and stop-neighborhood/placement-instability/consistency penalties.

columnMeaningGroups.identity_and_parameters: strategy_version identifies the reporting generator; policy/stop_policy names stop behavior; post_tp1_stop_fib_ratio is its numeric ratio (blank for no movement); asset, timeframe, entry_level, min_distance, min_move identify the reported parameter row; V6.5 v6_selection_* fields report its input V6 selection.
columnMeaningGroups.trade_and_equity_metrics: number_of_trades, trades_per_year, initial_capital, final_equity, total_return, annualized_return, net_pnl, gross_pnl, fees, slippage, profit_factor, expectancy, average_r, median_r, win_rate, average_win, average_loss, sharpe_ratio, sortino_ratio, calmar_ratio, maximum_drawdown, average_holding_duration report aggregate outcome metrics.
columnMeaningGroups.direction_and_exit_metrics: long_trades, short_trades, long_net_pnl, short_net_pnl, stop_before_tp1_rate, post_tp1_stop_exit_rate, tp1_reach_rate through tp5_reach_rate, long_average_r, long_win_rate, long_post_tp1_stop_rate, short_average_r, short_win_rate, short_post_tp1_stop_rate report directional/exit aggregates.
columnMeaningGroups.comparison_and_chronology_metrics: percentage_trades_improved_vs_A/_0880, percentage_trades_worsened_vs_A/_0880, average_incremental_r_vs_A/_0880, comparable_trades_vs_A/_0880 compare the named baseline; early_return and late_return are the generator's two equity-series halves; fees_slippage_ratio is a reported cost ratio; warnings is emitted warning text.
columnMeaningGroups.ranking_metrics: cost_penalty, asset_concentration_penalty, timeframe_concentration_penalty, nearby_parameter_penalty, out_of_sample_consistency_penalty, low_trade_penalty, performance_instability_penalty (V6), and stop_neighborhood_penalty, placement_instability_penalty, consistency_penalty (V6.5) are reported robust-score components; robust_score is the reported ranking score and robust_rank its reported ordinal rank. Meanings are code-derived, not historical-run provenance.
